intro: You find a book that looks as if nobody has opened it in ages, and it may be exactly what Troyas needs. It belongs to Daryn Lightwind, so you need to ask whether you may borrow it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This book looks as if no one has opened it for quite a long time. Its covers are quite worn, and its pages yellowed, but after examining it, you notice that it might be just what Troyas is looking for.
You pick it up, but realize you should probably ask before borrowing it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you'd like to borrow Feralas: A History?
I will allow you to borrow this book, friend, but only if you do something for me first.
